name: chart
purpose: Styles Recharts with semantic chart tokens, tooltips, and legends so series stay readable in light and dark.
bestFor: comparing a few named metrics over time
composed bar, line, or area charts with a shared config
avoidFor: tables that need exact cell-level comparison
maps or non-cartesian visualizations Recharts does not cover
